description: This file defines an interface for filtering or initializing server requests within the Laminas Diactoros library. It specifies a contract that implementing classes must follow to modify or process server request objects, such as injecting headers or rewriting URIs based on headers like X-Forwarded-* or Forwarded.

classes.name: FilterServerRequestInterface
classes.description: Interface for filtering or initializing server requests, allowing implementations to modify or process server request objects based on specific criteria or headers.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Determines if a request needs further modification, returning a new instance reflecting those modifications if necessary.
